name: body-phase
description: From the Damocles title screen, enter the starting world, capture once, wait, then capture again. The wait is the harness's own `wait_vbls`, which is a host sleep rather than a VBL count, so the gap is not fixed; what makes the captures usable is that each one carries the interrupt counter at $051D96, so the elapsed count is read out rather than assumed. The two RAM captures pin the per-Body phase-rate tables at $0082DC and $00835C, the 32 phase accumulators at $0062EA, and the body-centre arrays at $005F40/$00626A/$005FC0, so the accumulator advance can be checked against the derived rate and the centres can be hashed for orbit stasis (#439).
